page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a-nps1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on external storage solutions, and provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, including stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests, falls within the average range. Memory subsystem performance is notable, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top 25%, while large-block memory read and write bandwidths remain average. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-accelerated instructions such as AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, and ADX.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU and dedicated core allocation, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The combination of strong single-core performance and a large memory footprint makes it suitable for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy web serving.
